pcb.corner_hole_position_note: Hole centres retain KiCad coordinates. The measured outline is assumed centred on the KiCad outline, giving 3.05 mm nominal inset from measured edges; this inset was not separately measured.
pcb.deleted_hole: H1: upper-left OLED mounting hole; all four corner mounting holes remain

display.offset_datum: Upper mounting-hole centre to illuminated area top edge, downward with ribbon connector at top.

draft_assumptions.manufacturing: JLCPCB SLA resin, per user clarification.
draft_assumptions.form: Main shell with front panel and side walls, separate screw-fastened bottom cover, per sketch.

construction.source: User sketch IMG_7707.JPG and subsequent explicit clarification of PCB clamping and screw path.
construction.shell: Main shell with front panel and side walls; removable bottom cover.
construction.cover_fastening: Four original corner screws and coaxial post pairs retained. Deleted H1 is a display mounting hole, not a corner fastening hole.
construction.connector_cutouts: USB-C/ribbon keep original nominal sizes. Full-size SD uses a 24.6 x 2.6 slot, upper notch and supported tray sill, replacing the microSD finger recess.
construction.pcb_retention: PCB clamped between coaxial pairs of posts at all four existing corner mounting holes. Longer posts extend from upper shell to PCB top; very short posts extend from bottom cover to PCB underside.
construction.manufacturing_method: JLCPCB SLA resin; exact resin and screw remain to be selected.
construction.lower_post_bore: Clearance bore; screw threads engage the upper-shell post only.
construction.upper_post_bore: Pilot hole sized for the selected self-tapping screw and shell material.
construction.post_contact: Posts contact PCB locally around corner mounting holes; bottom-cover clearance must accommodate underside solder joints and display screw heads.
construction.bottom_cover: Tray with walls extending to PCB top level (Z=0), 2.5 mm clearance beneath PCB underside and short posts 2.5 mm long.
construction.pcb_outline_registration: Measured outline centred on the original KiCad outline; no scaling or displacement of mounting holes or components.
construction.sd_sill: Local tray wall extends 0.35 above the Z=0 joint under the SD slot; 0.2 mm clearance at each end.

nominal_connector_cutouts.note: SD slot includes SLA clearance and is centred on the new J3. USB-C/ribbon retain original dimensions.

sd_card_access.solution: Upper-shell notch and supported lower-tray sill; 0.2 mm sill end clearance. Original finger recess removed.
sd_card_access.note: Card seat height/insertion stop are provisional drawing-derived estimates. Confirm on assembled hardware. Card width/thickness and SLA dimensional variation make 24.2 x 2.2 too tight.

front_openings.source: User-specified opening diameters, 2026-11-07; supersedes the 4.8 mm button and 6.2 mm LED draft openings.

manufacturing.material: JLCPCB resin; specific resin not selected
